scientific_limitations: PM3D is a single-species cold dark matter solver; no gas, radiation transfer, baryons, stars, galaxies, planets, or life.
Initial conditions use Zel'dovich/1LPT (linear theory); not 2LPT; valid only in the linear/mildly nonlinear regime.
Reference power spectrum is an analytic Eisenstein & Hu-like approximation (Planck 2018-like), not CLASS/CAMB output; CLASS/CAMB import supported but optional.
Beyond shell crossing / strong nonlinearity only conservation is checked, not accuracy.
Force softening from CIC deposition and finite mesh resolution limit small-scale accuracy.
Error tolerances are regression guards, not independent accuracy proofs.
The browser viewer has not been rendered or clicked in a real browser in this environment; only its code was executed in Node/TestClient against real data.
CI workflow written but never executed; no Windows run performed.
This release does not simulate fully resolved galaxies, stars, planets, or life.
PM3D uses a periodic representative volume; finite-volume/cosmic-variance effects apply at low k.
